name: Enkaku Sousa -Shinjitsu e no 23 Nichikan-
original_name: 遠隔捜査 -真実への23日間-
source:
A person named Ichiro Shirakawa was murdered in the VIP room of the bar "Light Blue". Kouji Saito, who was drunk at the counter on the day of the incident, was arrested as a suspect. Saito, who claims false charges, decides to work with his attorney, Noriko Shinjou, to gather clues to prove his innocence while in jail. The time limit for prosecution is 23 days, which is the deadline for detention.

[from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E9%81%A0%E9%9A%94%E6%8D%9C%E6%9F%BB_-%E7%9C%9F%E5%AE%9F%E3%81%B8%E3%81%AE23%E6%97%A5%E9%96%93-]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
一名叫白川一郎的人在“Light Blue”酒吧的贵宾室中遭到杀害。案发当天在吧台喝醉的斋藤光志，被当作嫌疑人逮捕。坚称自己遭到冤枉的斋藤，决定在拘留期间与辩护律师新城法子合作，收集证明清白的线索。起诉时限为23天，也就是拘留期限。

[摘自[url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E9%81%A0%E9%9A%94%E6%8D%9C%E6%9F%BB_-%E7%9C%9F%E5%AE%9F%E3%81%B8%E3%81%AE23%E6%97%A5%E9%96%93-]维基百科[/url]]
